video_title: Channing Says Wemby Got ROBBED For MVP + Spurs vs Thunder WCF Predictions

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing questions Shai Gilgeous-Alexander's MVP stats
quotes.excerpt: I just think what did he lead the league in other than scoring?

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: Any surprise? Not with Shams. With Shai winning back-to-back.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Uh, I'm just hating? Other than I'm kind of hating a little bit. I'm kind of hating a little bit.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: I just think what did he lead the league in other than scoring?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: Oh god, don't do this, Channing. Please don't do this.

text_blocks.speaker: Allie Clifton
text_blocks.text: He didn't he didn't lead the league in scoring, did he?

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Oh, he didn't. Who did? Did he lead it in rebounding or blocks or steals?

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson argues wins are the most important stat
quotes.excerpt: Wins. The most important thing in our league is wins.
quotes.quote: Okay, really quickly. He didn't lead in any statistical categories. That's what everybody wants to say, okay? Right? Wins. The most important thing in our league is wins. I don't care about any of you sports nerds, any of you stat nerds, any of you the most important thing is wins.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard Jefferson defends Shai's MVP with historical record and consistency
quotes.excerpt: He broke a Wilt Chamberlain record. Yeah, he didn't lead in the stat, but he broke a historical record.
quotes.quote: They started off 24 and 1. He scored 20 points in every game this season. He broke a Wilt Chamberlain record. Yeah, he didn't lead in the stat, but he broke a historical record. 20 points for straight years. At 54% efficiency. He scored in 20 points, he scored 20 points in every game this season that he played. He broke a Wilt Chamberlain record.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing challenges Richard's 'wins only' MVP argument
quotes.excerpt: How does Russell Westbrook win an MVP?

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Wins are important stats. How does Russell Westbrook win an MVP?

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: No shit. But it is the stat. It is the only stat that matters. Team is the most important stat.

text_blocks.speaker: Channing Frye
text_blocks.text: Was that true? Jokic won it and they were fifth in the East. I think he won two of his three MVPs, they weren't one or two. They were eight and six without Shai. So.

text_blocks.speaker: Richard Jefferson
text_blocks.text: I couldn't agree. I couldn't agree. Why? Because he put up historical statistical categories.

quotes.speaker: Channing Frye
quotes.summary_phrase: Channing argues Victor Wembanyama deserved MVP for transformative impact
quotes.excerpt: I just think MVP to me, the most valuable player should go to the guy who has transformed his team.
quotes.quote: You have a 22-year-old who took a team. No, no, this is less about now. I'm not disagreeing with anything that you are saying. I just think MVP to me, the most valuable player should go to the guy who has transformed his team from each year it's going to be different, right? So obviously they won last year. Shai should have got that thing a thousand times last year. I thought this year, if I had a vote, that Wemby made the biggest impact on his team both defensively and offensively.

quotes.speaker: Richard Jefferson
quotes.summary_phrase: Richard summarizes MVP race, crediting Shai's team record as deciding factor
quotes.excerpt: Who had the best overall record in the NBA? And that was Shai's team.
quotes.quote: Dominance defensively because that's half the basketball game in Wemby. And then you look at consistency with with Shai. And especially because he had guys out. J-Dub, like I said, their All-NBA player missed majority like what? 50 games this year. And they still had the number one record? That's because that man every time he showed up, it was consistent. So I love the fact that the MVP race was among three juggernauts. Three absolute juggernauts. And what was the final deciding factor? Who had the best overall record in the NBA? And that was Shai's team.
